en.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Nine-Day Inflow Streak as Ethereum Funds Extend Their Run
slides: Bitcoin ETFs just ended their longest inflow streak of the year.
Spot Bitcoin funds shed 201.9 million dollars on August 28th alone.
Meanwhile Ethereum ETFs quietly extended their own streak to ten days.
The divergence suggests institutional appetite is shifting between crypto assets.
en.caption:
Bitcoin ETF inflows snapped a nine-day streak while Ethereum funds hit a ten-day run. Spot Bitcoin funds saw outflows of $201.9M on August 28th. Institutional capital is showing distinct preferences between Bitcoin and Ethereum.
